sessionParameters.label: Accelerating mode: 1 accelerating, 0 fixed at start_rpm

inputEvents.definition: The subject falls or passively rotates a full turn.

metrics.label: Latency to fall
metrics.definition: Fall time; without a fall by the cut-off, the latency is censored at max_trial_duration_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored; missing (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Fall detected
metrics.definition: 1 when a fall occurs by the cut-off, 0 when the whole trial was recorded without one.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored; missing (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Speed at fall
metrics.definition: Rod speed at the fall time; accelerating linearly from start_rpm to end_rpm, then constant.
metrics.formula: accelerating: start + (end - start) x min(t, acceleration_duration_s) / acceleration_duration_s; fixed: start_rpm
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) without a fall by the cut-off; also missing when not scored or incompletely recorded.
